Post.bodyHtml:
Most of what I have learned about shipping came from doing it badly first.

Start smaller than feels reasonable

The first version should embarrass you a little. If it does not, you waited too long.

  • Pick one user.
  • Pick one problem.
  • Ship by Friday.

You can just ship things.

Thanks for reading.
Post.subtitle: Notes on shipping before you feel ready.
Post.title: You Can Just Ship Things
